lines.zh: 发出低沉的咕噜声，步履蹒跚前行。
发出嘶嘶声，艰难地迈着沉重的步伐。
饥饿的低吼声中，慢慢踱步。
蹒跚前行，发出轻微的呼吸声。
嘶嘶地叫着，继续缓慢前行。
发出嘶嘶声，步伐缓慢而沉重。
嘶嘶声中，艰难地向前挪动。
咕噜着，一步步艰难前行。

lines.en: I walk with a blunted blade in my arms.
I skirt the rubble on quiet feet.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，眼中闪烁着贪婪的光芒。
lines.en: Staring at the player, eyes gleaming with greed.

lines.zh: 低头咀嚼着一块人类尸体。
用空洞的眼神盯着远处。
lines.en: Staring off into the distance with hollow eyes.

lines.zh: 咀嚼着人类遗骸，发出轻微的声音。
lines.en: Chewing on human remains, making soft sounds.

lines.zh: 我在数你背包里的罐头。
lines.en: I am counting the cans in your pack.
Pacing in place, waiting to act.

lines.zh: 低头咀嚼着什么，发出轻微的声音。
用空洞的眼神盯着玩家。
lines.en: Staring at the player with hollow eyes.

lines.zh: 突然转向玩家，露出尖牙。
lines.en: Suddenly turns to the player, showing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 注意到了玩家，嘶嘶地叫着。
盯着玩家，露出尖利的牙齿。
lines.en: Stares at the player, showing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 转向玩家，发出嘶嘶警告声。
lines.en: Turns to the player, hissing a warning.

lines.zh: 注意到玩家，发出嘶嘶声。
盯着玩家，发出嘶嘶威胁声。
lines.en: Stares at the player, hissing a threat.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，发出低沉的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Stares at the player, hissing softly.

lines.zh: 我的手套磨破了，指头在流血。
lines.en: My glove is worn through and my fingers bleed.

lines.zh: 我靠在墙角，喘得像风箱。
lines.en: I lean in the corner and wheeze like a bellows.
I am hit, who still has bandages?

lines.zh: 绷带全用完了，只剩这口气。
lines.en: All my bandages are gone. Only breath remains.

lines.zh: 这里食物很少，你能帮我吗？
lines.en: There's little food here. Can you help me?

lines.zh: 我的家就在那边，可以一起走吗？
lines.en: My home is over there. Can we go together?

lines.zh: 这些药草可以治愈你的伤口。
lines.en: These herbs can heal your wounds.

lines.zh: 给我点吃的，我好恢复力量。
lines.en: Feed me, so I can regain my strength.
Don't be afraid, I won't attack you.
I need your sword to fight.

lines.zh: 你可以教我怎样攻击吗？
lines.en: Can you teach me how to attack?

lines.zh: 我可以教你我的生存技巧。
lines.en: I can teach you my survival skills.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，手按在刀上。
lines.en: I step back half a pace, my hand on the knife.

lines.zh: 别靠过来，我手里只有钝刀。
lines.en: Stay back — all I have is a dull knife.

lines.zh: 你先别动，我不会攻击你的。
lines.en: Don't move, I won't attack you.

lines.zh: 让我先检查一下你的情况。
lines.en: Let me check on you first.

lines.zh: 你碰到了我，现在必须攻击你。
lines.en: You touched me, now you must attack.
You moved, I have to attack you.

lines.zh: 我需要你帮我，别攻击我。
lines.en: I need your help, don't attack me.

lines.zh: 跟我一起吧，我会保护你。
lines.en: Come with me, I'll protect you.

lines.zh: 守夜时有人换班，就够了。
lines.en: Someone to share the night watch is enough.

lines.zh: 这世道，两个人总比一个人强。
lines.en: In this world, two beats one.

lines.zh: 你看起来不错，想试试吗？
lines.en: You look good, want to try?

lines.zh: 捡起食物时发出微弱的嘶嘶声
lines.en: Whisper faintly when picking up food

lines.zh: 听到脚步声时转动脑袋
舔舐伤口以恢复生命值

lines.en: I grip an empty can and fix on you.
A shape moves among the ruins.
I grip my hilt and crouch.
I count the rhythm of its approach.
My blade points at its throat.
I back behind the broken wall.
Breathing slow, I wait for it to close.
My hands shake; I grip harder.
One, two, wait for it to turn.
I raise the blade to shoulder height.
Its steps are just past the corner.

lines.zh: 我把木棍举过头顶，砸下来。
lines.en: I raise the wooden club overhead and bring it down.

lines.zh: 我手里的木棍不是摆设。
lines.en: The stick in my hand isn't decoration.

lines.zh: 这条街尽头，只剩我一个。
lines.en: At this street's end, only me.

lines.zh: 我一脚踹翻挡路的椅子。
lines.en: I kick a chair out of my way.
I drive my blade into its chest!
I swing a club at its skull!
Kick it off before it bites!
Blade stuck, so I shoulder-check it!
Even on a bad leg, I swing!

lines.zh: 废墟里没剩什么，连罐头都空了。
lines.en: Nothing left in the ruins, not even a can.

lines.zh: 我从空罐头堆里抬起头。
lines.en: I lift my head out of the pile of empty cans.

lines.zh: 这条街上我认得每个门洞。
lines.en: I know every doorway on this street.

lines.zh: 总算找到个能住的地方。
lines.en: Finally found somewhere I can stay.
I'm alive, and I still have water.

lines.zh: 我从倒塌的楼里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a collapsed building.
Half a bottle of water is all I have left.
I brush the ash off my clothes.

lines.zh: 远处的吼声提醒我该走了。
lines.en: Distant howls tell me to move.

lines.zh: 我摔在瓦砾上，护住了头。
lines.en: I land in the rubble and shield my head.

lines.zh: 魔法之力摧毁了我的身体……
